# What's new in 1.3.1

Released **2026-10-10**. Full project history: [CHANGELOG.md](../../CHANGELOG.md).

## Highlights

- **Library sketches.** Each workout row shows a pale picture of its stages.
- **Window close.** The red button quits the app, so it leaves the Dock. A full-screen window still returns to the previous desktop first.

## Installer

- `steadyGrind-1.3.1-macos.dmg` (this folder)
- GitHub Release: https://github.com/attilameget/HomeWlanTrainer/releases/tag/v1.3.1
